import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_31/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_31/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on 'city' column as per operation history
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
# Target schema: ['type': string, 'city': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': float, 'driver_count': integer]

# Convert 'driver_count' to integer explicitly
df_joined['driver_count'] = df_joined['driver_count'].astype(int)

# Ensure 'fare' and 'ride_id' are float
df_joined['fare'] = df_joined['fare'].astype(float)
df_joined['ride_id'] = df_joined['ride_id'].astype(float)

# Select columns in target order
df_target = df_joined[['type', 'city', 'fare', 'ride_id', 'driver_count']]

# Write the result to the specified path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join by default)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by the leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema: type, city, driver_count
# Aggregate fare and ride_id by mean (to match target float values and reduce duplicates)
result = joined.groupby(["type", "city", "driver_count"], as_index=False).agg({
    "fare": "mean",
    "ride_id": "mean"
})

# Ensure column order matches target schema exactly
result = result[["type", "city", "fare", "ride_id", "driver_count"]]

# Write output to target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_31/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
